title: Novus Pharma — Eval & Signoff Playbook
customer: Novus Pharmaceuticals (Regulated CRO & drug safety group)
overview: Working draft: focused onboarding pack for Novus Pharma to validate LLM usage for adverse event triage, protocol summarization, and internal literature extraction. Includes pinned prompts, private dataset manifests, acceptance thresholds, regression checks, and recommended rollout steps.
model_candidate: redwood-open-7b-medfin-v2 (quantized int8) — baseline candidate for initial signoff. Alternate fallback: redwood-open-3b-medfast for low-latency endpoints.
private_datasets: novus_ae_reports_q1-q3_2024.parquet (annotated adverse events, 12k rows, PHI redacted per Novus-provided script)
novus_clinical_summaries_2018-2023.csv (protocol summaries and investigator notes, 4.2k docs)
novus_internal_faqs_2024.jsonl (internal SOPs and medical reviewer notes, 800 entries)
novus_pubmed_subset_2020-2024.parquet (curated literature subset used for retrieval augmentation, 18k abstracts)
pinned_prompts: AE_TRIAGE_SUMMARY — 'Read the following adverse event report and produce: severity (mild/moderate/severe), likely seriousness flag (yes/no), immediate action recommended (none/monitor/report/hospitalize), and 2-sentence rationale. Use conservative language and cite line numbers.'

PROTOCOL_QA — 'Given the protocol excerpt, answer whether the inclusion/exclusion criteria allow patients with chronic hepatic impairment. If ambiguous, list the ambiguous sentences and suggested clarifying question for the trial PI.'
LITERATURE_EXTRACTION — 'Extract the key findings, sample size, and limitations from this abstract. Format as bullet points and include PubMed ID.'

SENSITIVE_REWRITE — 'Rewrite the following investigator note to remove any personally identifying information and de-identify the patient while preserving clinical meaning. Mark removed elements with <REDACTED>.'
acceptance_criteria: Adverse-event classification: micro-F1 >= 0.84 on Novus private AE holdout (12k rows) with no class falling below 0.70 recall.
Triage action precision >= 0.88 at top-1 for 'hospitalize' predictions on holdout cases where ground truth is hospitalize.
Information extraction (literature): span-extraction exact match >= 0.80 on curated PubMed subset for 'sample size' and 'limitations'.
Hallucination rate <= 6% measured by manual eval on 150 random outputs (annotation rubric provided in linked Confluence).
Latency: P50 < 120ms and P95 < 400ms for text-generation endpoints on Dedicated small-gpu profile (batch size=1, seq_len=512).
Cost: token-unit cost per 1k tokens for production config must not exceed projected threshold in commercial worksheet (linked).
Security: model must run in Novus VPC private-deployment or Dedicated with customer-managed KMS for any production run that touches protected datasets.
regression_suite: AE_REG_2024_Q4 — 1,200 curated AE cases covering edge conditions (drug-drug interactions, comorbidity notes).
PROTO_CLARITY_90 — 250 protocol-ambiguity cases derived from Novus questions.
LIT_EXTRACTION_SMOKE — 500 abstracts for quick extraction sanity checks run nightly on staging.
HALLU_SMOKE_MANUAL — 150 human-annotated samples for periodic hallucination drift checks (weekly).
PERF_LOAD_TEST — synthetic stream to validate latency/throughput at 100 qps for burst windows.
metric_definitions: micro-F1: standard token-level classification F1 aggregated across adverse-event labels.
Hallucination rate: percent of outputs with at least one unsupported factual claim per human annotation protocol v2.
Precision@1: fraction of top suggestion matching ground truth for discrete action outputs (e.g., 'hospitalize').
Latency P50/P95: observed response time percentiles measured from model endpoint to Redwood gateway in region-us-west1.
recommended_deployment_config: Start in Dedicated (small-gpu) within Novus VPC for initial production. Enable prefix caching for protocol summaries, continuous batch size auto-tune set to conservative (max batch 8), and offload KV-cache to local NVMe. Use the medfin-v2 quantization profile from Redwood Optimize with fallback to medfast-3b for non-critical low-latency routes.
rollout_plan: Canary 1 (internal): 5% traffic within Novus staging for 72 hours, run full regression suite nightly.
Canary 2 (pilot): 25% traffic with subset of clinician users for 7 days, collect quality metrics and user feedback forms.
Full roll: 100% routing after two successful pilots and signoff. Enable automatic rollback if hallucination rate exceeds 8% or latency SLOs violated for >30m.
signoff_checklist: Model metrics meet all acceptance criteria on private holdout and cross-validated folds.
All regression tests pass on Dedicated staging for 72h under load.
Security review completed: KMS integration validated and audit logs flowing to Novus SIEM.
Legal/compliance: DPA and BAA clauses reviewed by Legal and countersigned.
Ops runbook updated with rollback and incident runbooks; on-call rotation assigned.
Novus internal reviewers (safety lead + clinical QA) provide written signoff in Confluence comment thread.
notes_to_engineers: TODO: add example golden outputs for AE_TRIAGE_SUMMARY prompt (10 high-priority cases). Watch for tokenization issues around legacy scan OCR text. For provable hallucination checks, pair with retrieval augmentation + citation normalization. Reach out to Novus data team to validate redaction script version (v3).
known_risks_and_mitigations: Risk: domain drift from new drug classes in 2025 -> Mitigation: monthly retrain schedule + active sampling of new AEs.
Risk: noisy OCR in legacy reports producing false positives -> Mitigation: add OCR confidence threshold and pre-filter step in ingestion pipeline.
Risk: overconfident binary outputs on rare conditions -> Mitigation: calibrate model probabilities and surface uncertainty tokens to downstream UI.
compliance_controls: PII/PHI handling: all private datasets stored in customer-dedicated S3 with server-side encryption and access limited via IAM roles. Use Redwood Private deployment gating for production flows that include PHI. Audit logs exported daily to Novus SIEM. QA reviewers must not download raw PHI; only hashed record ids are surfaced in review dashboards.
